name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Tree.root_encoding_leak
title: An LWE sample on a unit multiple of the gadget reveals s^T G (why the tree-encoding master root cannot be published)
statement: Over a commutative ring, let c be a unit and let Ginv satisfy G Ginv = c^{-1} G (for the binary gadget mod q, Ginv = G^{-1}(c^{-1} G) is a binary matrix). Then (s^T (c G) + e) Ginv = s^T G + e Ginv. In Tree Encodings I, G M_f = [h^T (x) G] for the public Merkle roots h, so a published master root s^T G M_f + e consists of samples s^T (h_j G) + e_j; any unit h_j turns one of them into s^T G plus short noise, which gadget decoding inverts.
